summary: Closure review: the manuscript remains high-quality and reproducible, but the mandatory Disclosure Statement still includes run-level file paths and full SHA‑256 hashes and therefore does not satisfy the track's concise‑disclosure requirement. Accept_for_finalisation is false until the Disclosure is condensed as specified below.
critical_issues: Mandatory Disclosure Statement contains run-level file paths and full SHA‑256 hashes (e.g., explicit file paths and per‑file hashes and master-prompt file hash) and duplicates execution-log level provenance in ordinary prose; this violates the track's concise Disclosure requirement and must be remediated.
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement into a single concise paragraph reporting only the mandatory items: LLM(s) used and model identifiers (e.g., gpt-5-mini), orchestration/adapter framework (hosted_netops_gvr_v1), canonical verifier identifier (deterministic_netops_validator_v5), existence of the preregistration (study id c1-gnr-vv-2026-0001), that execution and analysis artifacts/manifests are archived (name the execution manifest file or bundle) and provide at most one manifest‑level checksum, the autonomy-lock boundary (human selected topic and approved initial master prompt pre-lock; autonomous post-lock execution/analysis/manuscript generation), and an explicit statement that no human manually edited the manuscript after the autonomy lock. Remove all run-level file paths, per-episode filenames, and full SHA‑256 hashes from the Disclosure prose; instead refer readers to the named archived manifest for low‑level provenance and provide at most the single manifest-level checksum.
optional_revisions: Add one brief sentence in Methods clarifying that model_configuration.json records temperature = null and that null indicates provider-default sampling semantics (not evidence of deterministic sampling).

If space permits, add a short paragraph in Discussion contrasting how an independent-generation arm or a repair-enabled arm would change the estimand and enable non-degenerate inference, citing the archived sensitivity artifacts.
